name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: Manga-styled on/off button (Base UI or Radix toggle). Variants: default (frameless: inverts to ink on hover) and outline (2px frame on paper: lifts its tone shadow on hover). Sizes sm, default, lg. Off is paper; on (aria-pressed or data-state=on) is an ink flat that sweeps in over three frames. Click plays the impact (speed lines, 2px recoil). Disabled: dashed line, tone frame, label on paper, not-allowed cursor. Gestures: G2 flat, G3 hover, G4 impact.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/toggle". It wraps your own components/ui/toggle, so Radix and Base UI both work. Also exports toggleClassName, the look as a class string, used by ToggleGroup.

meta.tagline: An ink-lined switch that floods with ink when on.
meta.usage:
import { Toggle } from "@/components/ui/manga/toggle"

<Toggle aria-label="Bold" defaultPressed>Bold</Toggle>
<Toggle variant="outline" size="sm">Captions</Toggle>

props.name: variant
props.description: default: frameless, inverts on hover · outline: 2px frame, lifts on hover.

props.name: pressed / defaultPressed
props.description: Stock toggle state: on shows the ink flat.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dashed line, tone frame, label on paper.
